This device is intended for adjunctive use and not intended as a stand-alone diagnostic or prognostic too.

classification_name: Prognostic Test For Assessment Of Chronic Kidney Disease Progression
definition: A prognostic test for assessment of chronic kidney disease progression is an in vitro diagnostic device intended to measure one or more analytes obtained from human samples as an aid in assessing the risk for progression of   chronic kidney disease. definition: A pathology software algorithm device analyzing digital images for cancer prognosis is a software intended to analyze scanned whole slide images (WSIs) from prostate biopsies prepared from formalin fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue and stained using Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) stains.  The device provides prognostic risk estimates which are intended to assist physicians with prognostic risk-based decisions along with other clinicopathological factors. The device is not intended to determine a clinical diagnosis.
Hypertension machine learning-based notification software employs machine learning techniques to suggest the likelihood of hypertension for further referral or diagnostic follow-up.

classification_name: Ultrasound Imaging For Vascular Access For Hemodialysis
definition: Ultrasound imaging for vascular access for hemodialysis

classification_name: Radiological Software System For Delivery Date Prediction
definition: A radiological software system for delivery date prediction is a software-only device that analyzes obstetric radiological images to predict the delivery date of a pregnancy. The device output does not replace a clinician's review or judgment on the progression of a pregnancy and should be used in conjunction with other clinical and diagnostic findings. The device does not identify at-risk pregnancies or identify specific complications.

classification_name: Oct Imaging System With Ai/Ml Software For Adjunctive Detection Of Breast Cancer
definition: Intended as an adjunctive tool for intraoperative imaging and detection of cancer in breast tissue during excisional breast surgery (e.g., lumpectomy).

classification_name: Ear, Nose, And Throat Image Analyzer
definition: An ear, nose, and throat image analyzer is a device that uses software to analyze patient-specific optical images of the ear, nose, and throat area. The results are provided to healthcare providers as an aid to detection, diagnosis, or monitoring of ear, nose, and throat conditions.
